problem_statement: The network stack should support a Kconfig option to enable or disable checksum offloading at compile time. When checksum offloading is enabled and the underlying ethernet driver advertises hardware checksum capabilities via get_capabilities(), the stack must skip calculating TX and RX checksums (leaving them zero, for the hardware to fill). When offloading is disabled or the driver does not advertise the capability, the stack must calculate checksums in software. The test uses two virtual ethernet interfaces — one advertising offload capabilities and one not — to verify that packets on the offloading-enabled interface have zero checksums while those on the disabled interface have non-zero checksums, for both UDP and ICMP, fragmented and non-fragmented, IPv4 and IPv6.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/checksum_offload -s tests/net/checksum_offload/net.offload -s net.offload -O twister-out --no-clean -W
